guidance: POV posts outperform TIP posts (28.51 vs 0.97, n=10/14). Lean the week toward POV; keep TIP but make it earn its slot.
diagram graphics score 22.18 vs 0.66 for tip-card. Prefer diagram where the content allows.
Mon posts do best (28.53); Wed weakest (0.81). Put the strongest hook of the week on Mon.

coach_notes.reading: POV posts on diagram templates are driving nearly all meaningful engagement, with the top post outscoring everything else by a wide margin. TIP posts, especially on tip-card templates, are consistently the weakest performers regardless of hook. Monday is the only day with reliable signal, and long statement hooks addressed directly to 'you' outperform shorter or question-based hooks across the board.
instructions: Shift the weekly mix toward at least two POV posts built on diagram templates, and cut tip-card posts entirely for now since they have produced the lowest scores across multiple weeks.
Write every hook in second person and let it run long, at least fifteen words, making a direct claim or observation rather than opening with a question.
coach_notes.test_next: Publish one POV post on a non-Monday day, Wednesday or Friday, using the same diagram template and long second-person hook style, to learn whether Monday itself is driving the score or whether the post type is doing the work.
